message.content: {"caption":"Paired task-execution traces show a shopping agent choosing a compliant shirt and a household agent heating and placing an egg.","description":"Two side-by-side, color-coded textual workflow panels present task reasoning and actions. The left panel is headed “WebShop” with a shopping-cart icon. Its task is to find a women’s long-sleeve button-down shirt in navy blue, size large, machine washable, and under $40.00. A “Retrieved Skills” area identifies the task type as apparel and shows “General Skills” and “Task-Specific Skills.” Step 1 says the WebShop homepage has a search bar; the reasoning invokes [gen_001] “Prioritize Core Keywords” and [app_001] “Focus Key Query,” then searches for a women’s long-sleeve button-down shirt in navy blue (the displayed query ends with an ellipsis). Step 9 reports the product page has Navy Blue, size L, at $29.99. The reasoning cites [app_004] “Check Variant Price,” [app_005] “Confirm Hidden Specs,” and [gen_013] “Purchase Decisively,” concluding the item is within budget and should be bought; the action is “click[Buy Now],” followed by a green check mark. The right panel is headed “ALFWorld” with a small house-like icon. Its task is to heat an egg and put it on a countertop. Its “Retrieved Skills” area identifies the task type as heat and shows “General Skills” and “Task-Specific Skills.” Step 1 says the agent is in the middle of a room and begins looking around; the reasoning cites [gen_010] “Progressive Goal Decomposition,” [hea_004] “No Appliance Before Object” (do not go to the microwave first), and [hea_001] “Secure Exact Target First” (find the egg, checking the fridge and countertops). The action is to go to countertop 1. Step 8 reports arrival at countertop 1; [hea_005] directs placing the heated egg there, and the action is “put egg 1 in/on countertop 1,” followed by a green check mark. No arrows or other connections are shown.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
